ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This site-based course starts January 25 and ends May 10. Class sessions will be held in the Human Resources building (room 12) on Monday evenings from 6:00 to 9:00 PM on the University of Illinois at Springfield campus. Classes end on May 3 and the final exam will be on May 10. The email address for the instructor is PaulNKimK@msn.com.
